title: Fatal aircraft mishap and four lost hours

tellings.quote: stands out as a story was that uh we had an aircraft mishap where um one of our pilots died.

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he later worked with NASA, describes his time as an Army captain and flight surgeon, a doctor who looks after pilots, in a unit called the Third Attack Battalion. He says that during field work one of their pilots died in an aircraft accident, and that four hours around it went missing from memory. He tells it as one of the strange events that stand out from his career.
